mapper.sql: r.id, r.refund_no, r.order_id, r.order_no, r.user_id, r.refund_type, r.refund_reason, r.refund_amount, r.actual_refund_amount, r.currency, r.status, r.refund_channel, r.address_id, r.third_refund_no, r.apply_time, r.audit_time, r.auditor_id, r.audit_remark, r.refund_time, r.fail_reason, r.remark, r.extra, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.refund_no, r.refund_type, r.refund_reason, r.refund_amount, r.actual_refund_amount, r.status, r.apply_time, r.audit_time, r.audit_remark, r.refund_time, r.fail_reason, r.extra, au.nickname AS auditorName FROM sys_refund r LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = r.auditor_id WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY r.id ASC
